package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// jetStreamPublisher is deliberately the narrow part of JetStream used by the
// outbox publisher. Keeping this seam small lets the subject policy be proven
// without a broker while production still uses nats.JetStreamContext.
type jetStreamPublisher interface {
	PublishMsg(*natsgo.Msg, ...natsgo.PubOpt) (*natsgo.PubAck, error)
}

// Publisher connects lazily so a temporary broker outage cannot prevent the
// HTTP API and durable PostgreSQL outbox from accepting work.
type Publisher struct {
	URL            string
	Name           string
	ConnectTimeout time.Duration

	mu         sync.Mutex
	connection *natsgo.Conn
	jetStream  jetStreamPublisher
}

func (publisher *Publisher) Publish(ctx context.Context, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	if publisher == nil || strings.TrimSpace(publisher.URL) == "" || publisher.ConnectTimeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("invalid NATS publisher configuration")
	}
	if !allowedPlannerSubject(event.Subject) ||
		event.EventID == "" || !json.Valid(event.Payload) {
		return errors.New("invalid planner integration event")
	}
	jetStream, err := publisher.connectionContext()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	message := natsgo.NewMsg(event.Subject)
	message.Data = event.Payload
	message.Header.Set(natsgo.MsgIdHdr, event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Event-ID", event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Correlation-ID", event.CorrelationID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Causation-ID", event.CausationID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Schema-Version", strconv.Itoa(event.SchemaVersion))
	_, err = jetStream.PublishMsg(message, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	return err
}

func (publisher *Publisher) Close() {
	if publisher == nil {
		return
	}
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	if publisher.connection != nil {
		publisher.connection.Close()
	}
	publisher.connection = nil
	publisher.jetStream = nil
}

func allowedPlannerSubject(subject string) bool {
	switch subject {
	case domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted,
		domain.SubjectCoursePlanFailed,
		domain.SubjectOnboardingPathOutcome:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (publisher *Publisher) connectionContext() (jetStreamPublisher, error) {
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	// A nil connection with an injected publisher is test-only. Production
	// always establishes both values together below.
	if publisher.jetStream != nil && (publisher.connection == nil || !publisher.connection.IsClosed()) {
		return publisher.jetStream, nil
	}
	connection, err := natsgo.Connect(
		publisher.URL,
		natsgo.Name(publisher.Name),
		natsgo.Timeout(publisher.ConnectTimeout),
		natsgo.ReconnectWait(time.Second),
		natsgo.MaxReconnects(-1),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	jetStream, err := connection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		connection.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	publisher.connection = connection
	publisher.jetStream = jetStream
	return jetStream, nil
}

var _ domain.EventPublisher = (*Publisher)(nil)
